frame: World frame of the original AGIPIX v2 manufacturing STEP (Agipix_v2_original.stp): millimetres, +z up, the underside of the base frame (P01) at z = 0, +x toward the front (lidar and depth camera), the motor axes at x = +-98.84, y = +-131.50. All part B-reps, centres, bounds, feature points and local_to_world matrices are in this frame.

source.share: Autodesk A360 public share https://a360.co/4gY1h8M, design Agipix_v2, version 2

F12.name: corner block B (mirror image of A)

F18.name: ESC bracket B (mirror image of A)

F23.name: depth-camera rubber mount R (mirror image of L)

MOTOR.name: T-Motor 2306.3 1700 KV brushless motor
MOTOR.frame: origin on the shaft axis in the plane of the mounting face (the underside of the base); +z along the shaft toward the propeller end; +x from the shaft axis toward the centre of one of the four mounting slots of the base

PROP-CCW.name: Azure Power SFP 5148 tri-blade propeller, counter-clockwise
PROP-CCW.frame: origin on the rotation axis in the plane of the hub's lower face (the motor side); +z along the axis from the hub's lower face to its upper face; +x from the axis toward the tip of one blade

PROP-CW.name: Azure Power SFP 5148 tri-blade propeller, clockwise
PROP-CW.frame: origin on the rotation axis in the plane of the hub's lower face (the motor side); +z along the axis from the hub's lower face to its upper face; +x from the axis toward the tip of one blade

ESC.name: T-Motor F55A Pro II 4-in-1 ESC
ESC.frame: axes parallel to the board edges; origin at the centre of the four 3.0 mm mounting holes, in the plane of the highest point of the unit (the tops of the round bosses around the holes); +z normal to the board, pointing from the board to the boss tops; +x points away from the board edge with the protruding tab (the tab is on the -x side)

POWER.name: Power distribution board with XT60 plug
POWER.frame: axes parallel to the board edges; origin at the centre of the board's underside (centre of its outline), in the plane of the underside; +z normal to the board, toward the component side; +x across the board, +y toward the end that carries the XT60 plug

XT60-A.name: XT60 connector, female housing
XT60-A.frame: origin midway between the two contact axes, in the plane of the foremost point of the mating end; +z along the contacts, out of the mating end; +x along the line through the two contacts, from the chamfered (polarised) side of the housing toward the square side

XT60-B.name: XT60 connector, male housing
XT60-B.frame: origin midway between the two contact axes, in the plane of the foremost point of the mating end (the open shroud); +z along the contacts, out of the mating end; +x along the line through the two contacts, from the chamfered (polarised) side of the housing toward the square side

STANDOFF-7.name: M3 hex standoff, 7 mm
STANDOFF-7.frame: origin on the bore axis in the plane of one end face; +z along the axis into the standoff (the standoff occupies 0 <= z <= its length); +x from the axis toward one corner of the hexagon

STANDOFF-15.name: M3 hex standoff, 15 mm
STANDOFF-15.frame: origin on the bore axis in the plane of one end face; +z along the axis into the standoff (the standoff occupies 0 <= z <= its length); +x from the axis toward one corner of the hexagon

FC.name: CubePilot Cube Orange flight controller on its carrier board
FC.frame: axes parallel to the carrier board edges; origin in the plane of the carrier's underside (its largest downward face), on the centre line of the flight controller's four corner screws; +z up through the carrier to the flight controller cube; the carrier's row of connectors is on its -y edge (x then follows from y and z)

COMPUTE.name: Connect Tech Hadron carrier with NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX module and active heatsink
COMPUTE.frame: axes parallel to the carrier board edges; origin at the centre of the carrier board's four 2.75 mm corner mounting holes, in the plane of the board's underside; +z up, from the heatsink side of the board to the component side; +x along the board's short edges, toward the part of the board that is not above the heatsink (the heatsink under the board is offset to -x)

BATTERY.name: Tattu 4500 mAh 6S LiPo battery pack with lead and XT60
BATTERY.frame: axes parallel to the pack's faces; origin on the pack's top face (the large flat face on the side away from the lead's exit), midway between the two end faces and midway between the two side faces of the pack (the lead and its plug lie outside this box); +z normal to the top face, outward; +x along the pack's length, from the end where the lead leaves toward the plain end

LIDAR.name: Livox MID-360 lidar
LIDAR.frame: origin where the optical axis (the axis of the window and its ring) meets the plane of the base (mounting) face; +z along the optical axis, from the base toward the window; +x perpendicular to it, pointing away from the face that carries the connector

DEPTHCAM.name: Intel RealSense D455 depth camera
DEPTHCAM.frame: origin on the rear face, midway between the two rear threaded mounting holes; +z along the optical axis (normal to the front glass, pointing out of it); +x to the camera's right seen from behind with the tripod socket down; +y down, toward the tripod socket

DAMPER.name: M3 rubber vibration damper (stud and threaded hole)
DAMPER.frame: origin on the axis in the plane of the body's end face on the stud side; +z along the axis from the stud end toward the threaded-hole end (the stud occupies z < 0); +x perpendicular to the axis (the part is a body of revolution, so the direction of +x is arbitrary)

unscored.name: livox_connector
unscored.reason: the lidar's cable and plug, routed as wiring; wiring is outside the modelling scope

unscored.name: Solid44
unscored.reason: M3 countersunk screw (truncated) in the flight-controller pad; fasteners are outside the modelling scope

mass_properties.method: manufactured: exact B-rep volume x material density; purchased: the instance's mass spread over its constituents' volumes (uniform density per module)

conventions.features: concave cylindrical (and coaxial concave conical) faces of radius <= 8 mm, coaxial faces merged into one feature when they touch along the axis; point_mm = axis point at the opening, dir = axis into the material, depth = total axial length, steps from the opening inward; kind hole = every cylindrical step covers >= 300 deg, partial = at least one step >= 175 deg (slot ends, edge notches); smaller concave arcs (fillets) are not features; through features open on both ends and are entered from the end with the larger radius, on a tie from the positive side of the axis (dir has its largest component negative); ids <tag>.Hnn (holes) and <tag>.Unn (partial), numbered by decreasing radius, then position; coverage_deg = the smallest angular coverage of the feature's cylindrical steps
conventions.distances: pair distances are exact up to 1 mm (faces culled outside a 1 mm window); a larger reported value only means more than 1 mm
conventions.symmetry: rotations about the type's local +z axis through the local origin that map every constituent onto a constituent of equal volume within 0.05 mm (exact two-sided surface distance); order = largest n of 2..12 with all multiples, 'continuous' when generic angles also map; flip_symmetric = a half turn about a local transverse axis through the middle of the local z extent also maps
conventions.contact: min distance between exact solids <= 0.05 mm (overlap counts as contact)
conventions.interference: common volume > 0.01 mm^3 from exact booleans with a closed volume balance
conventions.rotor_disc: cylinder on the propeller axis, radius = the propeller's largest distance from its axis, axial span = the propeller's axial extent; axial values are measured from axis_point_mm along axis_dir; clearance = exact distance from the disc to every other scored solid, excluding the propeller and its own motor
